organization_and_why.profile_excerpt: Regional hub. We are the first call when a distributor has a full truckload to move. Refrigerated and frozen storage on site. Dock receiving; we can take full pallets.

whose_neighborhood.populations_served: General public, no proof of residence required
whose_neighborhood.tract: Nearest census tract: 15% of residents below the poverty line, 12% of households without a vehicle, 16% on food or cash assistance (ACS; recipient location is ZIP-level, so this is the area, not the exact block).

outreach_message:
Hello Greater Chicago Food Depository team,

A farm south of Chicago has 5 tons of potatoes. It is still good but has to move soon. From what we have on file you have the storage for it. The food needs to leave by about 72 hours from now, which leaves you roughly 36 hours of slack to collect. You are set up to collect it yourselves.

Can you take it? If you can, tell us the time you can collect and a phone number for pickup. If not, a quick no helps us move to the next place.

Thank you,
[Coordinator name]
